turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyText:
Yes, Fashion Nova ships internationally.

Customs and duties depend on the destination country and local customs rules. If your package is held at customs, you may be asked to provide proof of purchase (your Fashion Nova order confirmation email usually works) and sometimes ID verification.
